name: Diagnostic Medical Equipment Inc.
old_description: With over 15 years of expertise in healthcare, our core values are founded on mutual service and efficient delivery.
about:
Diagnostic Medical Equipment Inc. operates from Moore, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 2011. The company is led by CEO Arun Mirchia and has built a focus on supplying ultrasound systems to healthcare providers worldwide.

The firm distributes a broad range of GE Healthcare ultrasound platforms, including the Voluson, Logiq, and Vivid product families. Its inventory spans dozens of models — from the Voluson E10 and Logiq E9 to the Vivid E95 — and the company states it holds the largest stock of GE ultrasound units in the United States. Orders are supported by global shipping and crating services, with customer support available around the clock.

Customers include hospitals, polyclinics, and health centres seeking diagnostic imaging equipment. The company serves medical professionals and institutions across international markets, emphasizing quick response and logistics handling.

Diagnostic Medical Equipment says its founding principle was mutual service and efficient delivery, and it maintains a continuously updated inventory to match evolving clinical needs. The combination of deep product availability and 24/7 access is presented as its core differentiation.

name: Diamed
old_description: We can purify, conjugate and modify antibodies to your specifications. Whether you need bulk amounts or research scale batches, our services can be scaled in accordance with your needs.
about:
DiaMed, Inc. is headquartered in Windham, Maine, and has specialized in antibody products since its founding in 1983. The privately held company operates as a manufacturer of antibody-related products and services, though ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides antibody purification, conjugation, and modification services, scaling from research-scale batches to bulk production. It also manufactures research-scale batches of purified, labeled, and modified antibody products to support clients' development processes. Additionally, DiaMed sells excess conjugated antibody material from prior production runs, offering an economic pricing model for those products.

DiaMed serves research and development organizations, biotechnology firms, and pharmaceutical companies engaged in antibody-based product development. Its services are tailored to clients needing custom antibody processing, from early-stage research through larger-scale production.

The company emphasizes scalable service offerings that adapt to client needs, whether for small research quantities or larger bulk orders. Its economic pricing model for excess conjugated antibodies provides cost-effective access to pre-made materials, and its ability to adjust final concentration and buffer systems adds flexibility for specific applications.

name: Diamond Electric Mfg. Corp
old_description: We deliver fantastic products and are committed to quality through dedicated teamwork.
about:
Diamond Electric Mfg. Corp traces its roots to 1937 when Inosuke Tomita founded Diamond Electric in Japan. The company established its U.S. presence in 1990 with Nobu Hashimoto as the first president of Diamond Electric United States (DEUS). After a groundbreaking ceremony in April 1996 attended by then-Governor Gaston Caperton, the Eleanor, West Virginia plant began mass production of ignition coils in May 1997. The corporate headquarters remains in Eleanor, WV, while a sales and design center operates in Farmington Hills, Michigan, near Detroit’s automotive hub.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes automotive electrical components, specializing in ignition coils for original equipment manufacturers. Its U.S. operations encompass manufacturing at the Eleanor facility, which has undergone multiple expansions since 1997, and engineering support from the Michigan center. Products are thoroughly tested to meet OEM standards, and the firm emphasizes research as a key step in new product development.

Diamond Electric serves three primary customer segments: global OEM automotive manufacturers, service part retailers, and DIY installers. Its ignition coils are supplied to major automakers, and the company has earned quality and delivery awards from several of them, including a President’s Product Quality Award from Subaru of Indiana Automotive in 2004.

The company’s stated philosophy—“We Are Diverse Shiny Diamonds. We Are Seeking the Happiness of Our Comrades, By Supporting Our Customers First, By Contributing to Society, With the Commitment to Earn Their Trust”—drives a quality policy focused on on-time, defect-free delivery and constant improvement through teamwork. Community involvement is also highlighted, with donations to local parks and schools in Putnam County.

The company has served the Central Arkansas region for over four decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. The business functions as a retail supplier of home medical equipment and supplies, carrying products from manufacturers such as Pride Mobility and Golden Technology. Its showroom — described as the largest in Arkansas — stocks mobility devices including power chairs, scooters, and lift chairs, alongside daily living aids. Customers include individuals, caretakers, medical professionals, nursing homes, and assisted living facilities. Diamond Medical bills Medicaid, all PASSE programs, and major medical insurance plans directly, and provides flexible payment options for items not covered by insurance.

The company emphasizes personal service — calls are answered by staff rather than automated systems, with after-hours support available — and highlights its four-decade track record and expansive showroom as reasons customers choose them.

name: Digitron Semiconductors
old_description: The military quality level is designed for customers whose applications require the parts to be fully robust and reliable in military applications
about:
Digitron Semiconductors operates from Kenilworth, New Jersey. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures high‑reliability discrete semiconductors, including Zener diodes, transient voltage suppressors, rectifiers, and a range of transistors such as BJTs, JFETs, and MOSFETs. It serves four quality tiers—military, aerospace, industrial, and commercial—each with defined test flows. Military‑grade parts receive MIL‑PRF‑19500 JANTX‑equivalent screening, including temperature cycling and burn‑in, all performed in Digitron's internal test laboratory. The firm emphasizes a high product mix with low‑ to mid‑volume runs and stable year‑over‑year pricing.

Customers span defense, aerospace, industrial equipment, and consumer electronics. Military and aerospace buyers rely on the company's ability to meet stringent specifications and provide lot‑based test reports and certificates of compliance. Industrial clients receive extended temperature testing and customized flows, while commercial customers still benefit from four levels of 100 % inspection yielding a 0.99998 assurance level.

Digitron positions itself on mitigating supply‑chain risk through broad product availability, reasonable lead times, and consistent pricing, backed by an AS9100:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 registered quality system.

name: Direct Wire (Direct Wire & Cable)
old_description: Direct Wire is a leading manufacturer of industry-best wire and cable systems and assemblies
about:
Direct Wire was founded in 1977 in a home garage in Pennsylvania. Today the company is headquartered in Denver, Pennsylvania, with additional distribution facilities in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

The company manufactures wire and cable systems and assemblies under brands such as Flex-A-Prene, Ultra-Flex, All-Flex, Veri-Flex, and Dura-Flex. Its product range includes welding cable, power cable, entertainment cable, extension cords, diesel locomotive (DLO) cable, flexible power cable for data centers, and oxygen-free copper rod and stems in 8 mm and 12.5 mm diameters produced in Lancaster. In-house capabilities cover cable assembly, color and striping (including a proprietary longitudinal striping process pioneered in 2000), inkjet and indent printing, repair and spark testing, copper recycling, private labeling, and same-day or next-day fulfillment from its Pennsylvania warehouses.

Direct Wire serves renewable energy (solar, wind, EV, battery storage), industrial and OEM, power and renewables, data centers, welding, battery, entertainment, oil and gas, mining, rental equipment, vehicle and transit, appliance and electronics, distribution, and manufacturing sectors. Reference customers include Michigan CAT, IWS Gas and Supply, and ILMO Products Company.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing as a core differentiator, stating that domestic production yields higher quality, shorter lead times, and American jobs. Its operating philosophy centers on 'Service. Technology. People.' and is backed by an on-site quality lab that performs resistance, fault, cold-bend, mechanical, and flame testing to UL, ASTM, SAE, and MSHA standards.

Dirt Road Steel differentiates itself through its veteran ownership, commitment to domestic manufacturing, and made-to-order model with free shipping on all orders. The brand highlights the unique character of each hand-carved piece.

name: Diversified Metal Fabricators
old_description: Custom duct, fittings, and one-off parts when the stock item will not work. Send a drawing or photo.
about:
Diversified Metal Fabricators operates from Ferndale, Michigan, where it was established in 1993. The privately held shop serves the Detroit metro area with custom sheet metal work.

The company fabricates custom ductwork, fittings, transitions, plenums, and one-off parts when catalog items do not fit field conditions. It also produces brackets, signs, panels, covers, and other repeatable parts in premium galvanized steel. Processes include cutting, bending, forming, and mechanical joint assembly without exposed fasteners. The shop handles orders ranging from single pieces to production quantities.

Primary customers are HVAC contractors, mechanical contractors, and retrofit crews who need parts that match existing field dimensions. The company also works directly with homeowners requiring custom duct transitions or replacement fittings. Examples include ductwork that will not land on the job, custom carts, and residential retrofit pieces.

Diversified Metal Fabricators emphasizes a streamlined quoting process: customers can send a drawing, photo of a print, marked-up screenshot, hand sketch, or the old part itself. The team offers field measurement assistance and walks through the part before quoting. Finished parts are fabricated to precise specifications and made ready for quick pickup.

name: Diversified Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Diversified Plastics has become an integral working partner with us at McClain Oil Tools. Steve Kirgan has been working with us since 2014 to make sure our needs are met. From communication to the exceptional parts we buy, everything is top notch. Any issue that has come up has been resolved in a timely manner. We are grateful to continue to grow alongside Diversified Plastics.
about:
Diversified Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1976 by Rod Reid in his garage in Missoula, Montana, initially supplying engineered plastic wear strips to lumber and pulp mills in the surrounding area. The family-owned business is now led by Reid's son, Brad Reid, a mechanical engineer, alongside a team of manufacturing professionals.

The company operates as a custom plastics fabrication and engineering firm, offering injection molding of UHMW-PE and other resins, cast urethane, CNC machining, thermoforming, and custom fabrication under one roof. Its MultiFab approach combines these processes to produce hybrid components. By the end of 2025, the 3.5-acre campus will encompass over 60,000 square feet of building space with four 80,000-pound silos. The shop runs injection molding machines with shot capacities from 19 to 311 ounces and delivers tens of thousands of parts annually.

Diversified Plastics serves industries including industrial wastewater treatment, mining, forest products, grain handling, car wash equipment, oil and gas, and food and beverage. Customers range from international wastewater treatment leaders to local Montana breweries. The company ships to more than 15 countries and supports OEM replacement parts, maintenance, and new product development.

The firm differentiates itself through its proprietary injection molding of UHMW virgin and regrind materials, in-house tool design and mold fabrication, and Lean Production protocols.
